Both cap blocks opened and every coefficient checks. WEB §1t5957s0§.as:3340-3346: level into _loc2_, then MAXHP < 10+(lvl+10)*10, MAXCHI < 10+(lvl+10)*5, MAXAP < 30+(lvl+10)*5, ATK/DEF/SPD < 1+(lvl+10)*3 — the quoted :3343 line is verbatim. ANDROID InventoryUI.as:2406-2412: MAXHP < 10+(lvl+10)*5, MAXCHI < 10+(lvl+10)*5, MAXAP < 20+(lvl+10), ATK/DEF/SPD < lvl+10 — verbatim. And the per-point grants they are being matched against are real: web §1t5957s0§.as:3394/:3406/:3414/:3422/:3434/:3443 give 10/5/5/3/3/3, android InventoryUI.as:2417/:2424/:2432/:2439/:2446/:2453 give 5/5/1/1/1/1. Two scope notes. (a) 'caps are exactly the per-point grant times the point budget' is loose — (level+10) is not the stat-point budget; what is exactly true, and is the whole content, is that each cap's per-level coefficient EQUALS that build's per-point grant. (b) The finding UNDERSELLS itself: put level 80 into the web ATK/DEF/SPD cap and you get 1+90*3 = 271 exactly, which means RR:201's '271 cap is gear/rebirth-inclusive' is not merely replaceable, it is FALSE. I file that separately.

InventoryUI.as:2429-2433 is verbatim 'public function APaddHandle(event:MouseEvent) : void { StatsManager.changeStat(StatsManager.STAT_STATPOINTS,-1); StatsManager.addMaxAP(1);', and its five siblings read +5 MAXHP (:2417), +5 MAXCHI (:2424), +1 ATK (:2439), +1 DEF (:2446), +1 SPD (:2453). The independent android auto-allocator at StatsManager.as:1669-1683 does read +5/+5/+1/+1, so the finding is right that the +1AP is the manual panel and not the auto-allocator. The web twin is confirmed both at the binding it names (§1t5957s0§.as:3334 'this.statsPanel.HPadd.addEventListener') and at the handlers themselves: :3394 +10, :3406 +5 CHI, :3414 §1t9609s0§(5) = +5 AP, :3422/:3434/:3443 +3/+3/+3. So RR:77 and RR:199's '+10HP/+5Chi/+1AP/+3-stat' really is a two-build chimera — web ships 10/5/5/3/3/3 and android ships 5/5/1/1/1/1, and no build ever shipped the ledger's row. The strongest and cleanest overturn in the packet.

new_findings.text: REBUILD_READINESS.md:201 says the "271 cap" is gear/rebirth-inclusive and that a 237-point first-run budget makes 271 impossible in one stat, then files it as 'resolvable by arithmetic now'. It is not an arithmetic puzzle and it is not gear-inclusive: 271 is the literal hard-coded per-stat ceiling of the WEB build at the level cap. §1t5957s0§.as:3340 reads the character level into _loc2_ and :3344-3346 gate the ATK / DEF / SPD add buttons on 'stat < 1 + (_loc2_ + 10) * 3'. At level 80 that is 1 + 90*3 = 271 EXACTLY. The same block gives the other three ceilings for free: MAXHP < 10 + (level+10)*10 = 910 at L80, MAXCHI < 10 + (level+10)*5 = 460, MAXAP < 30 + (level+10)*5 = 480. Android's numbers are different (5 / 5 / 1 / 1 coefficients, InventoryUI.as:2407-2412) and do NOT produce 271, which is a second confirmation that 271 is a v0.717 web datum. No reconstruction needed, and the 237-point-budget reasoning in the ledger is answering a question the code never asked.

The web rebirth function falsifies the whole sentence, tenthGold included. §1t1523s0§.as:2638 opens the rebirth routine; :2644-2648 read 'if(§1t7356s0§(§1t9426s0§) == 8) { §1t9713s0§(§1t9413s0§,100); ... getString(864,[...,"10"]) }' and :2649-2651 'else { §1t9713s0§(§1t9413s0§,25); }'. §1t9413s0§ = 12, which is STAT_HGOLD in the android constant table (StatsManager.as:194). So the web build pays 25 hard-gold per rebirth and 100 on the rebirth that promotes you to the tenth dan — tenthGold=100 exactly, and a 10th-rebirth tier that the ledger says does not exist. :2653-2655 then hard-caps the ladder: 'if(§1t7356s0§(§1t9426s0§) < 9) { §1t9713s0§(§1t9426s0§,1); }' — the dan stat can never exceed 9, i.e. ten rungs ending at 十段.
